CREATE VIEW [Finance].[vw_CUS__AlternateGLAccountData] WITH SCHEMABINDING AS SELECT [AlternateChartCode] = Chart.AlternateChartCode, [AlternateChartKey] = Chart.AlternateChartKey, [AlternateGLAccountKey] = Account.AlternateGLAccountKey, [Attribute_LFE] = ISNULL(AttributeTable.Attribute_LFE, ''), [Attribute_LFO] = ISNULL(AttributeTable.Attribute_LFO, ''), [Attribute_OCG] = ISNULL(AttributeTable.Attribute_OCG, ''), [Attribute_ORG] = ISNULL(AttributeTable.Attribute_ORG, ''), [Attribute_SPR] = ISNULL(AttributeTable.Attribute_SPR, ''), [Attribute_TIC] = ISNULL(AttributeTable.Attribute_TIC, ''), [CashFlowType] = AttributeTable.CashFlowType, [CompanyKey] = Chart.CompanyKey, [GLAccountKey] = AttributeTable.GLAccountKey, [OriginalAccount] = Account.AccountNum, [PrintSequence] = Account.PrintSequence, [ReportSection] = Account.ReportSection, [StatisticalUnits] = AttributeTable.Units, [TotalLevel] = Account.TotalLevel, [DestinationAccountNo] = AlternateNoInfo.DestNo, [TierLevel] = AlternateNoInfo.TierLevel, [ParentGLAccountNo] = AttributeTable.ParentGLAccountNo, [ParentGLAccountName] = AttributeTable.ParentGLAccountName, [AccountNumberForTotals] = CASE WHEN Account.ReportSection = 'TS' THEN '1' WHEN Account.ReportSection = 'OV' THEN '2' WHEN Account.ReportSection = 'AP' THEN '3' WHEN Account.ReportSection = 'OE' THEN '4' WHEN Account.ReportSection = 'AS' AND Chart.BalanceSheetStyle = 'EAL' THEN '5' WHEN Account.ReportSection = 'LI' AND Chart.BalanceSheetStyle = 'EAL' THEN '6' WHEN Account.ReportSection = 'AS' AND Chart.BalanceSheetStyle = 'ELA' THEN '6' WHEN Account.ReportSection = 'LI' AND Chart.BalanceSheetStyle = 'ELA' THEN '5' ELSE '0' END + AlternateNoInfo.DestNo, [Description] = Account.[Description], [AccountTypeCode] = Account.AccountType, [AccountType] = CASE Account.AccountType WHEN 'BSH' THEN 'Balance Sheet' WHEN 'P&L' THEN 'Profit & Loss' WHEN 'ALT' THEN 'Alternate' WHEN 'CLN' THEN 'Consolidation' WHEN 'HDR' THEN 'Header' WHEN 'TTL' THEN 'Total' ELSE Account.AccountType END, [DebitCredit] = CASE Account.DebitCredit WHEN 'CR' THEN 'Credit' WHEN 'DR' THEN 'Debit' ELSE Account.DebitCredit END, [DebitCreditCode] = Account.DebitCredit, [AlternateAccountKey] = Account.AlternateNumKey, [ConsolidationAccountKey] = Account.ConsolidateNumKey, [PercentAccountKey] = Account.PercentNumKey, [HeaderDependsOnTotalKey] = Account.HeaderDependsOnTotalKey, [OrganizationKey] = [AttributeTable].OrganizationKey
FROM [Finance].[BAS__AlternateGLAccount] Account JOIN [Finance].[BAS__AlternateChart] AS Chart ON Chart.AlternateChartKey = Account.AlternateChartKey LEFT JOIN [Finance].[CUS__AlternateGLAccountAttributeInfo] AttributeTable ON Account.AlternateGLAccountKey = AttributeTable.AlternateGLAccountKey AND Account.AlternateChartKey = AttributeTable.AlternateChartKey OUTER APPLY [dbo].GetAlternateChartNoInfo(Account.AccountNum, Account.AlternateChartKey) AlternateNoInfo
